description: Domain-restricted structural comparison of AlphaFold models with a functional control, plus per-residue pLDDT profiles
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests

def read_ca(path):
    xyz={}; plddt={}
    for l in open(path):
        if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA":
            r=int(l[22:26]); xyz[r]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
            plddt[r]=float(l[60:66])
    return xyz, plddt

def up(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

def nw(a,bq,gap=-6):
    n,m=len(a),len(bq); sc=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    sc[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap; sc[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap; ptr[1:,0]=1; ptr[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=sc[i-1,j-1]+(2 if ai==bq[j-1] else -2); u=sc[i-1,j]+gap; l=sc[i,j-1]+gap
            k=int(np.argmax((d,u,l))); sc[i,j]=(d,u,l)[k]; ptr[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; pairs=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=ptr[i,j]
        if p==0: pairs.append((i,j)); i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pairs[::-1]

def kabsch_rmsd(P,Q):
    Pc=P-P.mean(0); Qc=Q-Q.mean(0)
    V,S,W=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W)); D=np.diag([1,1,d])
    R=V@D@W
    return float(np.sqrt(((Pc@R-Qc)**2).sum()/len(P)))

ALL={"Mal63p (functional, inducible)":"E9P8G3","Mal23p (functional, inducible)":"E9P8G2",
     "Mal23-Cp (functional, CONSTITUTIVE)":"E9P8G1","mal64p (non-functional)":"Q9UVH4",
     "Mal33p (non-functional, S288C)":"P38157","Mal13p (non-functional, S288C)":"P53338"}
SEQ={k:up(v) for k,v in ALL.items()}
ST={k:read_ca(f"af/AF-{v}.pdb") for k,v in ALL.items()}

DOM=[("Zn2Cys6 motif",8,34),("DNA-binding region",1,100),("transactivation core",60,283),
     ("inhibitory region",251,299),("maltose-responsive C-term",300,470)]
ref="Mal63p (functional, inducible)"
rows=[]
for k in ALL:
    if k==ref: continue
    pr=nw(SEQ[ref],SEQ[k])
    for dn,s,e in DOM:
        P=[];Q=[]
        for i,j in pr:
            if s<=i<=e and i in ST[ref][0] and j in ST[k][0]:
                P.append(ST[ref][0][i]); Q.append(ST[k][0][j])
        rows.append(dict(allele=k, domain=dn, n_CA=len(P),
                         rmsd_A=round(kabsch_rmsd(np.array(P),np.array(Q)),2) if len(P)>5 else np.nan,
                         mean_pLDDT=round(np.mean([ST[k][1][j] for i,j in pr if s<=i<=e and j in ST[k][1]]),1)))
r=pd.DataFrame(rows)
piv=r.pivot(index="allele",columns="domain",values="rmsd_A")[[d[0] for d in DOM]]
pl =r.pivot(index="allele",columns="domain",values="mean_pLDDT")[[d[0] for d in DOM]]
print("Domain-restricted CA RMSD to the Mal63p AlphaFold model (A):"); print(piv.to_string())
print("\nMean pLDDT per domain:"); print(pl.to_string())
r.to_csv("mal33_structure_domain_rmsd.csv",index=False)

status={"Mal23p (functional, inducible)":"functional","Mal23-Cp (functional, CONSTITUTIVE)":"functional",
        "mal64p (non-functional)":"non-functional","Mal33p (non-functional, S288C)":"non-functional",
        "Mal13p (non-functional, S288C)":"non-functional"}
fun=[a for a in piv.index if status[a]=="functional"]; non=[a for a in piv.index if status[a]=="non-functional"]
print("\nDiscrimination check (functional vs non-functional alleles):")
for d,_,_ in [(d[0],0,0) for d in DOM]:
    print(f"  {d:28s} functional {np.round(piv.loc[fun,d].values,2)}  "
          f"non-functional {np.round(piv.loc[non,d].values,2)}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,8.4))
ax=axes[0]
x=np.arange(len(DOM)); w=0.15
cols={"Mal23p (functional, inducible)":"#e67e22","Mal23-Cp (functional, CONSTITUTIVE)":"#c0392b",
      "mal64p (non-functional)":"#7d3c98","Mal33p (non-functional, S288C)":"#117a65",
      "Mal13p (non-functional, S288C)":"#1a5276"}
for i,a in enumerate(piv.index):
    ax.bar(x+(i-2)*w, piv.loc[a].values, w, label=a+(" *" if status[a]=="non-functional" else ""),
           color=cols[a], hatch="//" if status[a]=="non-functional" else None, edgecolor="k", lw=0.4)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([d[0] for d in DOM], fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("CA RMSD to Mal63p model (A)")
ax.set_title("AlphaFold models do not separate functional from non-functional MAL activators\n(hatched = non-functional allele)")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, ncol=2)
ax=axes[1]
for a in ["Mal63p (functional, inducible)"]+list(piv.index):
    xyz,pld=ST[a]; xs=sorted(pld); ys=np.array([pld[i] for i in xs])
    W=11; ys=np.convolve(ys,np.ones(W)/W,mode="same")
    ax.plot(xs,ys,lw=2 if "Mal33p" in a else 1.2,
            color="#000000" if a==ref else cols.get(a,"#888888"),label=a)
for s,e,c,lab in [(1,100,"#2e86c1","DNA binding"),(60,283,"#f1c40f","transactivation core"),
                  (251,299,"#e74c3c","inhibitory"),(300,470,"#27ae60","maltose-responsive")]:
    ax.axvspan(s,e,color=c,alpha=0.07)
ax.set_xlabel("residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT (11-residue mean)"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title("Per-residue AlphaFold confidence is the same for functional and non-functional alleles")
ax.legend(fontsize=8,ncol=2,loc="lower right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
